# La Dulce

> La Dulce is a café, brunch spot and covered terrace in Los Abrigos, southern
> Tenerife (Canary Islands, Spain). Known for the Canarian barraquito coffee,
> pancakes, Eggs Benedict, avocado toast, smash burgers and homemade cheesecake.
> Family-friendly, average price €10–20 per person, rated 4.4 on Google (757 reviews).

## Key facts
- Name: La Dulce
- Type: Café / brunch / coffee shop with terrace
- Location: Av. los Abrigos, 2, 38618 Los Abrigos, Granadilla de Abona, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain
- Coordinates: 28.0295188, -16.5937985
- Phone: +34 922 74 92 19
- WhatsApp reservations: +34 615 02 99 41
- Email: ladulcelosabrigos@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday to Sunday 08:30–22:30, closed Mondays (brunch until 14:00, burgers from 12:00)
- Price range: €10–20 per person
- Reservations: yes, via WhatsApp or phone
- Takeaway: yes. Dine-in: yes.
- Good for: families with children (stroller space), specialty coffee, weekend brunch
- Dietary: vegan option (HEÜRA burger), gluten-free pulga rolls on request, salads, bowls
- Languages: Spanish and English
